scientific_integrity: Finite ranks were established by exact modular elimination; a signed integral unit minor proves a primitive basis in the complete 2-cell chain lattice. Product torus boundaries and the full cellular boundary identity were checked, and the top-kernel rank argument supplies the integral conclusion. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for the unordered configuration of exactly two points on the thirty-vertex Tutte–Coxeter graph. Only integral degree-two homology and the natural six-label permutation action are classified. No uniform family result, full graph-automorphism module, or full homology computation is claimed. An unindexed equivalent statement remains possible.
title: A single octagon-pair orbit gives an integral basis for Tutte–Coxeter two-particle homology
